description.zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以通过[DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~)接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括集群ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.
> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of all clusters under your account, including cluster IDs.

description.zh:
是否查询Fuse挂载信息，取值如下
- **true**：是
- **false**：否，默认值
description.en:
Specifies whether to query Fuse mount information. Valid values:
- **true**: Yes.
- **false**: No. This is the default value.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-polar-fs-attribute --polar-fs-instance-id pfs-2ze0i74ka60700000 --query-fuse-mount-info false --db-cluster-id pc-bp1q76364ird00000 --region cn-hangzhou
